title: Addus HomeCare to Participate in the 2026 Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Addus HomeCare's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://addus.gcs-web.com/node/14686/pdf)


FRISCO, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 8, 2026-- Addus HomeCare Corporation (Nasdaq: ADUS), a provider of home care services, today announced that Brian Poff, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, and Brad Bickham, Chief Operating Officer on an Interim Basis, will participate in the 2026 Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference, September 14 - 15, 2026, in Nashville, Tennessee.


In connection with the conference, there will be a live broadcast and replay of the Company’s presentation available under the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website,[www.addus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Faddus.com%2F&esheet=54600320&newsitemid=20260908465129&lan=en-US&anchor=www.addus.com&index=1&md5=7b3ffdd32d7739f2279c4a4b1b0deeac) , starting at 8:00 a.m. Central Time / 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, September 15, 2026. An online replay will also be available on the Company’s website for one month, beginning approximately one hour following the conclusion of the live broadcast.


**About Addus HomeCare**


Addus HomeCare is a provider of home care services that primarily include personal care services that assist with activities of daily living, as well as hospice and home health services. Addus HomeCare’s consumers are primarily persons who, without these services, are at risk of hospitalization or institutionalization, such as the elderly, chronically ill and disabled. Addus HomeCare’s payor clients include federal, state, and local governmental agencies, managed care organizations, commercial insurers, and private individuals. Addus HomeCare currently provides home care services to approximately 62,500 consumers through 264 locations across 24 states. For more information, please visit[www.addus.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.addus.com%2F&esheet=54600320&newsitemid=20260908465129&lan=en-US&anchor=www.addus.com&index=2&md5=d0072704d899cc3a3db0658e74a54c97) .
